security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown examples, local URLs, SQLModel Session.exec calls, and normal environment configuration. The Dapr quick start uses curl piped to bash, which is a real critical install risk if followed. Semantic review also found JWT audience verification disabled and SQL query logging enabled in examples.

remediation.suggestion: Replace the curl pipe command with pinned package manager steps or checksum-verified downloads before publishing.
Require audience and issuer validation in JWT examples, and document where deployment-specific values come from.
Set SQLAlchemy echo to false in production examples and warn users before enabling verbose SQL logs.

semantic_findings.title: JWT Audience Verification Disabled
semantic_findings.description: The JWT example disables audience verification. Generated APIs could accept tokens meant for another service unless users restore audience and issuer checks.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The decode example explicitly disables audience verification in an authentication pattern. This is a clear production security weakness if copied unchanged.

semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Both examples create engines with verbose SQL logging enabled. The risk is contextual but important for production backend guidance.

content.value_statement: FastAPI microservices need consistent database, auth, messaging, and testing patterns. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through SQLModel, Dapr, JWT, and production scaffolding.
actual_capabilities: Provides FastAPI CRUD, dependency injection, JWT/JWKS, and OpenAPI patterns.
Shows SQLModel schema design, async sessions, relationships, queries, and migrations.
Documents Dapr pub/sub subscriptions, CloudEvent handling, publishing, jobs, and sidecar usage.
Includes production logging, request IDs, repository and service layers, testing, and API versioning.
Offers project structure guidance for backend apps, routers, services, Dapr handlers, and tests.
limitations: It provides patterns and examples, not a complete generated application.
Dapr Jobs API examples use an alpha endpoint and may need version checks.
Database, auth, and CORS values must be reviewed for each deployment.
It does not replace security review for generated production code.

use_cases.title: Create a REST API foundation
use_cases.description: Start a FastAPI backend with SQLModel models, CRUD endpoints, dependency injection, and tests.

use_cases.title: Add event-driven messaging
use_cases.description: Connect a FastAPI service to Dapr pub/sub with CloudEvent handling and publish helpers.

use_cases.title: Prepare production service patterns
use_cases.description: Add structured logging, repository layers, service layers, versioning, and async test fixtures.

prompt_templates.title: Start a FastAPI API
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to create a basic FastAPI task API with SQLModel models, CRUD routes, and pytest coverage. Keep the first version small.

prompt_templates.title: Add JWT authentication
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to add JWT/JWKS authentication to an existing FastAPI API. Include protected routes, error handling, and Swagger authorization.

prompt_templates.title: Integrate Dapr pub/sub
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to add Dapr pub/sub to a FastAPI service. Include subscription discovery, CloudEvent unwrapping, publish helpers, and local testing steps.

prompt_templates.title: Design a production microservice
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to design a production FastAPI microservice with SQLModel, Dapr jobs, service layers, structured logging, versioning, and test strategy.

output_examples.input: Create a task service with CRUD endpoints and database models.
output: Testing guidance for create, read, update, and list behavior.

output_examples.input: Add Dapr messaging and scheduled reminders.
output: Subscription and publish flow for Dapr pub/sub.
Job callback guidance for reminder processing.

output_examples.input: Prepare production readiness for a FastAPI API.
output_examples.output: Logging, dependency injection, versioning, and async testing recommendations.

best_practices: Review generated auth, CORS, and database configuration before deployment.
Keep Dapr component names, topics, and callback paths consistent across services.
Add tests for database sessions, event handlers, authentication failures, and pagination.
anti_patterns: Do not copy placeholder database credentials into production configuration.
Do not expose Dapr callback routes without network and authentication controls.
Do not disable JWT validation checks without a documented deployment reason.

faq.question: What does this skill help build?
faq.answer: It helps build FastAPI backends with SQLModel, Dapr messaging, JWT authentication, and production testing patterns.

faq.question: Does it generate a full application automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides implementation patterns and scaffolding guidance that users adapt to their project.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Can it help with Dapr jobs?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes Dapr Jobs API patterns, callback behavior, and local testing guidance.

faq.question: Does it cover database migrations?
faq.answer: Yes. The SQLModel reference includes Alembic setup, migration commands, and common operations.

faq.question: Should generated code be security reviewed?
faq.answer: Yes. Users should review JWT validation, CORS policy, secrets handling, and Dapr route exposure.
